candidate_extensions.claim: A stage must declare whether it is a FILTER, TRANSFORM, or PASS_THROUGH stage before low throughput can be called a bottleneck.
candidate_extensions.risk: Could excuse real failure by calling every loss intentional filtering.

candidate_extensions.claim: A gate pass may claim only properties it directly measures, unless a proxy relationship to the claimed property is separately validated.
candidate_extensions.risk: Could add excessive formalism to simple gates.

candidate_extensions.claim: When downstream prerequisites, authority, and every unique evidence/safety obligation are already satisfied, optional intermediate stages may be bypassed rather than executed for sequence purity.
candidate_extensions.risk: A speed optimization may silently skip a unique obligation.

candidate_extensions.claim: Past time, effort, money, clicks, or prior approvals must never be treated as current consent, validity, authority, or fit.
candidate_extensions.risk: May duplicate stale-approval and capability-vs-authority rules unless it catches a distinct historical-commitment failure class.
